**Current**
- Experts disagree on drafting him. One says he is ranked too low and is a late-round swing pick and deep-bench stash. A newer take says nothing in preseason makes drafting him make sense. (verdict, 2026-10-13; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1407), [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1704), [10-13](https://youtu.be/OsbUAkSeVB4?t=1556))
- He is projected to come off the bench. Ty Jerome is the starting point guard and started both preseason games. (fact, 2026-10-08; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1342), [08-17](https://youtu.be/LcZcvk8s1xQ?t=490), [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=867), [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1812), [10-08](https://youtu.be/6DnRWahYrFA?t=1780), [10-12](https://youtu.be/ENizLoE6pzI?t=1231))
- His toe injury from last season is reportedly healed. (fact, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1342), [08-17](https://youtu.be/LcZcvk8s1xQ?t=490))
- He is likely the sixth man, competing with Jaylen Wells for bench minutes and with Jerome for point guard minutes. (verdict, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1342), [08-17](https://youtu.be/LcZcvk8s1xQ?t=490))
- He has been working at shooting guard, so he could start next to Jerome. (fact, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1384))
- He would be a must add everywhere if Jerome gets hurt and Pippen moves into the starting lineup. (verdict, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1384))
- Memphis is expected to use an 11 or 12 man rotation with short, hard stints and a high pace, which keeps bench minutes down. (verdict, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=146), [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=296), [08-17](https://youtu.be/LcZcvk8s1xQ?t=1033), [08-17](https://youtu.be/LcZcvk8s1xQ?t=1159))
- Memphis has a maxed 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks through March 28 and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league. (fact, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1987))

**Durable**
- Steals are his standout category, far above the top 250 pool. Assists are his other positive category. (fact, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1360), stats)
- He is a strong perimeter defender. (fact, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1360))
- He is less useful in points leagues than in category leagues. (verdict, 2026-10-07; [10-07](https://youtu.be/lp11OAEpq4Y?t=1407))

**Tags**
- Current: `minutes competition` (bench role behind Ty Jerome, competing with Jaylen Wells), `handcuff` (must add if Ty Jerome gets hurt), `injury last season` (toe injury, now reportedly healed), `flyer` (late-round swing per one expert; a newer take doubts him after preseason), `waiver watch` (watch his minutes and Jerome's health), `deep rotation` (11 or 12 man rotation), `fast pace` (Iisalo plays at a very high pace), `low starter minutes` (Iisalo uses short stints and keeps minutes down), `good playoff schedule` (4-4-4 in weeks 19 to 21), `few back-to-backs` (13 back-to-backs), `unsettled rotation` (crowded guard group; Lloyd finds the Grizzlies hard to figure out)
- Durable: `STL specialist` (about 1.6 steals per game projected), `category league player` (value from steals and assists, less useful in points leagues)

**Note.** He ranks 166 on Yahoo and 134 on ESPN, and both sites price him at about 0 USD. With only 144 players drafted, he sits at the edge of our draft pool, so he costs at most 1 USD as a last bench pick for builds that chase steals and assists. Early in the season, check his minutes against Jaylen Wells and Ty Jerome's health, because a starting role would make him a must add.
